Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part IV, Section E, Line 2a: Identify Supported Orgs. and Explain How Activities Furthered Exempt Pu
Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: Section E, 2a, Activities Test - Direct Furtherance: Substantially all of our activities are direct furtherance activities, performed by our supporting organization and not the organization which we support. Of the 21 member Board, only two Board members are responsible for fundraising. The remaining 19 Board members are devoted to furthering the supported organizations exempt purpose. They do so by organizing and executing educational assemblies and enrichments, after school care programs, and seasonal activities for the staff and school community. They also serve to improve communications between the school and the parent community, ensure the Boards activities are aligned with the supported organizations needs and goals, and ensure the Boards activities are reported to the supported organization.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part IV, Section E, Line 2b: Reasons For The Organization's Position
Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: Section E, 2b, Activities Test - Organizational Involvement: We strive to serve as additional resources for the school, alleviating the workload that would normally fall to our supported organization. Were it not for our efforts, employees of our supported organization would be organizing and executing these same efforts.
